## What & why

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` new functionality
- [ ] `fix` bug fix
- [ ] `docs` / `chore` / `ci` / `refactor`
- [ ] `test`

## Checklist

- [ ] Builds and tests pass locally or in CI for the affected targets
- [ ] Docs / README updated if behaviour, configuration or a command changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the diff
- [ ] Commits are small, conventional (`feat(scope): ...`) and signed off (`git commit -s`)
